meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: Claude 自动推高版本号，同步所有清单文件，跑构建校验，打 git 标签、发 GitHub release、更新 changelog，npm 发布留给你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 升级版本或发布新版本时，它会启动这套自动化发布流程。

say.text: 帮我发一个 patch 版本，走完整发布流程。
准备 v1.0.1 的发布，在 npm 前停下来等我。
say.note: 它会做完所有准备，等你执行npm publish。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically bumps the plugin version, syncs all manifest files, runs build checks, creates a git tag, publishes a GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, and leaves the npm publish for you to run manually.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask Claude to upgrade a version or publish a new release, running the full automated release workflow.

say_en.text: Bump a patch version and run the full release flow.
say_en.note: Claude does all automated steps, then asks you to npm publish.

say_en.text: Do a minor upgrade, build, tag, and create a GitHub release.
say_en.note: Updates version, release notes, and changelog.

say_en.text: Prepare v1.0.1 release and stop before npm for me.
say_en.note: It finishes preparation and waits for your npm publish.
